ios.desc:
Stop wasting food. Start making amazing meals.

Got random ingredients in your fridge? RecipePal instantly turns them into delicious, personalized recipes. No more "what's for dinner?" stress. Just type what you have (or snap a photo) and get cooking.

Why Cooks Love RecipePal:
- Create Grocery Lists & Share them with friends & Family 
- 15-Minute Meals - Quick recipes for busy weeknights
- Snap & Cook - Photo scan detects ingredients in seconds (Beta)
- Personalized to You - Vegan, gluten-free, spicy, mild—your choice
- Perfect Portions - Scale recipes from 1 to 10+ servings

How It Works:
1. Enter your ingredients (or scan a photo)
2. Set your preferences
3. Get a recipe in 30 seconds
4. Save your favorites into your own cookbook

Perfect For:
- Busy parents needing fast family meals
- College students cooking on a budget
- Food lovers exploring new flavors
- Health-conscious eaters with dietary needs
- Anyone tired of wasting groceries

Download RecipePal and turn your fridge into dinner. Your wallet and your taste buds will thank you.
